description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface. It forwards log messages to the Android Log system and optionally chains log nodes together for sequential processing.
external_methods: Log.println(int priority, String tag, String msg)

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's Log utility, allowing logs to be forwarded and chained among multiple LogNodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the subsequent LogNode to receive log data after this node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs messages to Android's log system, appends stack trace if throwable is provided, and forwards the log to the next node if present.
